description: Type any city to see its current temperature, feels-like temperature, humidity and wind, plus a 5-day forecast powered by our live weather API.

faqs.a: The tool calls ToolNest's own weather API, which returns current conditions and a 5-day forecast for the place you enter.
faqs.q: Where does the weather data come from?

faqs.a: If the API cannot find the place you typed, you will see a friendly "Place not found" message. Try a larger nearby city or a different spelling.
Temperatures are shown in degrees Celsius, and wind speed in kilometers per hour.

howto: Type a city name in the search box (e.g. Lahore).
Click "Get Weather" to fetch the forecast.
Read the current conditions card at the top.
Scroll down to see the 5-day forecast cards.
title: Weather App
